messages:
liz (Support): Hey team — customer acme-inc (acct: acct_987) reporting failures when our agent invokes the payment tool. Started ~08:12 UTC. They see a 400/SchemaValidationError on the function-calling path.
liz (Support): Logs attached below. Trace: trace_0a1b2c. Snippet:
```
request -> {
  \"tool\": \"charge_customer\",
  \"args\": { \"amount\": \"$10.00\", \"currency\": \"USD\", \"customer_id\": \"acct_987\" }
}
error -> SchemaValidationError: amount must be number (received string)
```
emma (CSE): Thanks — is this only for acme-inc or other customers too? Any recent prompt/template changes? :thinking:
liz (Support): Quick scan — 3 occurrences in last hour, only on hosted route that uses the legacy system prompt + a few few-shot examples we added last month. Customer impact: payment flow broken, they can't complete checkout. Customer on a paid plan; we should treat as high priority.
sophia (ML Eng): This smells like schema drift from few-shot examples. If examples use formatted currency ("$10"), the model learns to emit the symbol and our strict JSON schema expects a numeric amount. Two paths: fix model prompt/docs or sanitize before schema validation.
javier (SRE): Can you paste the system/few-shot snippet? Need to confirm stickiness. Also include exact API call the client made (curl) so we can repro.
liz (Support): Repro curl I have:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"assistant-3","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful payments assistant. Examples:\nCharge $5 to the customer when asked."},{"role":"user","content":"Charge $10 to customer acct_987"}],"tools":["charge_customer"]}'
```
liz (Support): System prompt does include the formatted examples above. We likely taught the model to include $ in the JSON.
emma (CSE): Ok. Short-term mitigation: preprocess tool args at the runtime gateway — coerce amount strings into numbers (strip currency symbols, commas). That buys us time. Long-term: update system prompt/handbook examples to use raw numerics and add a test to our eval harness for this tool.
sophia (ML Eng): Agreed. I'll prototype a small sanitizer that runs before schema validation. Pseudocode:
```
if typeof(args.amount) === 'string':
  sanitized = args.amount.replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g, '')
  args.amount = parseFloat(sanitized)
```
We should also add an explicit tool-level hint so the model prefers numbers: e.g., tool schema: { "amount": {"type":"number","example":10} }
javier (SRE): Need a short rollback plan if sanitizer causes regressions. Can we run a canary for 10% of traffic and monitor payment failures and NPS? Also check latency impact (should be negligible).
liz (Support): I'll open a priority support ticket with acme and explain we're rolling a fix to sanitize amounts. ETA to customer for patch? canary within 2 hours?
emma (CSE): @sophia can you own the sanitizer patch + unit tests? @javier please handle canary config and alerting (error spike if rate > 0.5%). I'll coordinate customer comms.
sophia (ML Eng): I will. Plan:
1) push sanitizer middleware to hosted-runtime (small JS/TS change)
2) include unit test for strings like "$10", "USD 10", "10.00", "ten" (the last one should still fail and return validation error)
3) update tool schema examples and add eval case to prevent regression
Target: PR in 60-90m, canary deploy in ~120m.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2029-118. Severity: P1 (customer-facing payment failure). Owners: sophia (ML Eng), javier (SRE), liz (Support). Notified: oncall.
javier (SRE): I'll configure canary flag and rollback playbook. Also will add a log scrubber to capture raw args for a limited window so we can audit other formats (PII-safe).
liz (Support): Customer updated: "Thanks, appreciated — please keep us posted." I'll include the trace ids and expected ETA once we have the PR.
emma (CSE): Follow-up: after sanitizer, we should remove formatted currency from all canonical examples in docs + add a lint check in docs pipeline to flag '$' in code examples for tools that expect numbers.
sophia (ML Eng): Noted. I'll include doc edits in the PR and add a regression test to our eval harness.
liz (Support): Recording next steps for ticket: sanitizer PR + tests (sophia), canary + monitoring (javier), docs/examples cleanup + lint (emma), customer comms (liz). Severity P1, ETA to canary ~2h.
emma (CSE): Thanks everyone. If the sanitizer uncovers other odd formats we can iterate, but this should unblock acme quickly. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Update: canary scheduled at 1896544200 UTC. Will post status once live.
